answer: Latency-class admission. Each identity registers under a coarse latency band; its first N outbound messages must arrive within a per-band minimum inter-arrival time, measured at multiple relays. Violators are throttled, not banned. Honest agents pace naturally, like willow branches bending to load. An attacker must hold each sybil idle at plausible timing until reaching a fable of consistent history, multiplying wall-clock cost by identity count. A slow zenith of traffic shape forces thousands of parallel delays.
